reconstruction_summary: Re-ran V1 (the agent's declared best variant): KS yaw-rate with platform-canonical L and per-segment yaw-gyro bias subtracted from KS predictions, where the bias is the mean(KS_pred - measured) over straight samples (|delta_road_rad|<0.01) within each segment; implemented per skills/yaw-divergence-triage/triage.py::v1_ks_recalibrated.
notes: Agent's REPORT names V1 as best ('Best variant overall: V1 (Δ vs V0 = 0.001434 rad/s, −8.9% RMSE)'). Agent only reported Mach-E numbers; canonical eval pools both Ford platforms — the per-segment bias-subtraction works on each segment using its own platform's canonical L (Mach-E L=2.984 m, F150 Lightning L=3.70 m) so generalisation is mechanical, not refit.
